### Notes

- DERIVATION DEPENDENCY: SDTM QSSL carries only the 5 SWLS items (SWLS0101..SWLS0105) and NO total-score record. PARAMCD 'SWLSTOT' must be derived in ADQSSWL as the sum of the 5 item scores, with an explicit completeness rule: set the total to missing unless all 5 items are non-missing at that visit. Record the rule in the ADaM define.
- LOCF-DEPENDENT with the same visit sparsity as PHQ-9 (13 at baseline, 2 observed at Week 24).
- LOCF imputation assumed — no SAP provided.
- N-GATE CAVEAT: this study has 17 randomized subjects (Placebo 5 / Low 5 / High 7). All inferential statistics are illustrative and must not be interpreted.
- **Denominator note.** The Efficacy population is N=13, but this analysis has n=9. The difference is not a dropped record: the population flag spans all three delivered efficacy instruments (PHQ-9, SWLS, AVLT-REY), whereas this table requires a non-missing baseline AND a Week-24 analysis value for THIS parameter specifically. The per-arm 'n' rows above are the analysis denominators; the column headers show the population size.
- Model: `CHG ~ TRTP + BASE`. LS-means via `emmeans::emmeans` with equal reference-grid weighting (the SAS LSMEANS default); contrasts via `emmeans::contrast` with explicit coefficient lists so each difference reads dose - comparator.
- **SITEGR1 was dropped from the model**: MANDATORY RULE 3 pooled all 6 sites into group 900 on randomized counts, leaving a single-level (rank-deficient) factor. Refitted as shown above.
- The 'n observed / n LOCF-imputed' row is shown on the table face because 1 of 9 analysis values are carried forward.
- All values computed from ADaM via the persisted ARD (`ard.csv`); no value is hand-entered.
- Rounding: SAS convention (half away from zero), applied at display time only.

> **N-GATE WARNING.** This study randomized 17 subjects (Placebo 5 / Zanomaline Low 5 / Zanomaline High 7). Every inferential statistic in this display is **illustrative only** and must not be interpreted as evidence of effect or of absence of effect.
